danny.audio_profile: Danny Ruiz, 38, a night security guard and dad. Warm, a little gravelly, with a dry sense of humor. He tells his story like a gripping YouTube storyteller: quick, confident, conversational and energetic, never melodramatic.

marcus.audio_profile: Marcus, 22, a big, easygoing young man with a deep voice, a night security guard and nursing student, suddenly seeing something scary in the parking garage and talking low into his walkie-talkie.

scene: Danny tells a camera, at a brisk pace, how a zombie outbreak started at the mall where he works. Clear, close to the microphone, no music.
sample_context: A first-person survival story told as a fast-paced YouTube narration.

chunks.text: [low, matter-of-fact] There's a zombie pressed against my gate. And it's wearing my best friend's uniform.
[quick, tense] The radio on his chest is about to tell every one of them where I'm hiding.
[wry] An hour ago, I was the king of this mall. Let me back up.
[upbeat, dry] I'm Danny. Night security at Maplecrest Mall. Yes, I've heard every mall cop joke.
[warm] I work nights for one reason: at three-fifteen every afternoon, I'm at the bus stop when my daughter Lily gets off the bus.
[proud, smiling] She's seven, and she thinks I'm the king of the mall. Because I carry forty-two keys. One for every store. [lower] Tonight, I'd need exactly one.
[brisk] The job is simple. Walk the loop. Rattle the gates. And at one a.m., take a call from Marcus down in the parking garage.
[amused] Marcus is twenty-two, he's studying to be a nurse, and he tells the worst jokes on Earth.
[serious] Tonight he calls at one-forty. No joke. He's whispering.
[low, tense] Danny. There's a guy on the ramp. He's walking... wrong.
